snippet.title: Megafortress (Dos PC) Intro & Gameplay / Three-Sixty Pacific, Inc. /1991
snippet.description:
Tried to get airborne...

Megafortress is a flight simulation based on the premise of Dale Brown 's Flight of the Old Dog 
novel. The player is in command of a crew flying a super modified and experimental B-52 bomber, 
outfitted with the latest weapons and stealth technology. (In the novel, it was more advanced than 
the B-1 Excalibur, the Strategic Air Command's most advanced bomber).

The game campaign mostly takes place in Iraq, but there is 1 mission that takes the bomber to the 
old Soviet Union like in the novel.
